purpose: Pass costs behind the in-pass checkpoint layer-group plan (PrefillPassCost) and the time its captures add
device: gfx1151 (Strix Halo), ROCm 10.1, power profile balanced
source: upstream main 07e1191f with the in-pass checkpoint change

pass_cost.method: One QwenGpuExecutor, ForwardPromptBatch of `rows` prompt tokens from position 2,048 with logits, after restoring the same 2,048-token prefix; median of three runs after a warm-up. Run alone on an otherwise idle machine: at most 0.26 cores of other CPU load in 89 samples.
pass_cost.model: 120 ms + 2.25 ms per row; 1.80 ms per row where UseQwen27bFp16Prefill selects FP16 activations (UD-Q4_K_XL, 1,024 rows or more)

draft_injection.method: Temporary timers in a gufo serve llm build (UD-Q4_K_XL + DFlash2, --sessions 4), around the target pass and InjectTargetContext of each Prime/ExtendPrompt, while three greedy decoders ran beside a 2,558-token prompt.
draft_injection.model: 0.12 ms per row after the pass

in_pass_capture.method: Same temporary build, AR and DFlash2 runs: wall time of each in-pass consumer call (cache admission, capture and publication of one boundary) on the 27B.
in_pass_capture.note: Not part of the layer-group plan: a group of the 2,558-token prompt beside four sessions lasts about 1.2 s.
